purpose: Define deterministic Runner failure, retry, cancellation and compensation semantics without erasing prior execution evidence or silently continuing across hard failures.

topics.name: Runner Failure and Recovery
topics.purpose: Define deterministic Runner failure, retry, cancellation and compensation semantics without erasing prior execution evidence or silently continuing across hard failures.

semantics.failure_rule: Hard-failed step stops dependent execution unless explicit recovery policy says otherwise.
semantics.retry_rule: Retry policy is explicit and bounded; each attempt has distinct evidence.
semantics.cancel_rule: Cancellation is explicit and propagates according to dependency policy.
semantics.compensation_rule: Compensation is an explicit operation/step, not deletion of prior effects/evidence.
semantics.resume_rule: Resume identifies exact prior execution/checkpoint and applicable policy.
semantics.event_rule: Failure/retry/cancel/compensation transitions may emit explicit Events.

invariants.rule: Runner definition, runner execution, individual step execution, operation dispatch and emitted Events are distinct explicit identities connected by traceable execution/causality relations.

references.purpose: Recovery applies to explicit step executions.

prose.summary: Define deterministic Runner failure, retry, cancellation and compensation semantics without erasing prior execution evidence or silently continuing across hard failures.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against Routine/Runner, Event/Trigger causality and command dispatch contracts.
